messages:
eli: heads-up — want to land a small proposal for how we map runtime routing failures -> client-facing statuses and console banners. quick sync?
nina: yes please. rough problem: clients see opaque 500s for lots of different root causes (quota, out-of-capacity, model mismatch). we need a deterministic mapping and clear console badging.
prasad: big ask is to preserve retry semantics. some '500' are transient (GPU OOM, preempt) and should be retryable, others (quota) should not.
eli: proposal draft: expose a thin client contract with three buckets: RETRYABLE (503 + Retry-After), QUOTA (429 + quota headers), PERMANENT (4xx-like, no retry). console shows per-route badge: green/amber/red with hover text.
nina: +1 on buckets. what about graceful fallback routing? e.g., when model variant B is used instead of A, clients should get 200 but console should surface that a fallback happened.
prasad: agree — we should not hide fallbacks. suggest response include header `X-Redwood-Route` with values `primary|fallback` and `X-Redwood-Route-Reason` with short code like `CAPACITY_CONSTRAINT`.
eli: sample response snippet for retryable case:
```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Content-Type: application/json
Retry-After: 5
X-Redwood-Status: RETRYABLE
X-Redwood-Route: primary

{ "error": "service temporarily unavailable, please retry" }
```
nina: will add to docs. console UX: show banner on the route page with pill: "Transient errors: 12h avg 5% — retries enabled" and link to runbook. also show trendline next to latency.
prasad: telemetry: ingest `redwood.status_bucket` tag with values `retryable,quota,permanent,ok` and export to traces. we should also emit `route_variant` and `model_hash` to correlate fallbacks.
eli: important: quota vs billing — 429 should have `X-Quota-Bucket` and `X-Quota-Remaining` so SDKs can choose to backoff or surface billing warnings in-app.
nina: SDK behavior notes: for RETRYABLE -> exponential jittered retries; for QUOTA -> surface in-app warning to customer; for PERMANENT -> surface error with a link to support + runbook id.
prasad: rollout: start with 5 beta customers on dedicated routes, enable `X-Redwood-Status` only for SDK v2.0 to avoid surprising clients. console-bot will auto-create an "incidents" ticket when retryable spikes > 10% in 1h.
eli: action items: nina to write console copy + banner designs, prasad to add headers and telemetry, me to update SDK retry logic + docs. deploy-bot: can we gate this behind a feature flag?
deploy-bot: feature flag `route-status-headers` created in staging. default off for prod.
eli: timeline: aim for staging rollout end of next week, beta customers following week. any objections?
nina: none from me.
prasad: no objections. will PR telemetry schema today.
eli: cool — final note: keep client-visible strings short, machine-readable headers preferred. avoid adding new status codes; reuse 503/429/4xx where appropriate and add machine headers for nuance. :thumbsup:
